identity.explanation: Posti Oyj is the main Finnish postal service delivering mail and parcels in Finland, as confirmed by its official website, LinkedIn profile, and Wikipedia. It is owned by the Government of Finland.

overview.description: Posti Group Oyj (formerly Suomen Posti and Itella) is the primary Finnish postal service, delivering mail and parcels in Finland. Internationally, it operates as Posti Group Corporation and is a leading delivery and fulfillment company across the Nordic and Baltic countries. The company connects people and businesses by delivering information, emotions, and goods. Posti is undergoing a digital transformation, including modernizing its financial technology platform and leveraging AI and automation.
overview.industry: Postal service, Logistics, Supply Chain, Storage, Financial process automation
overview.businessModel: Posti Group operates as a logistics and delivery service provider for both business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-consumer (B2C) segments, offering postal services, parcel and freight delivery, warehousing, and in-house logistics. It also provides financial process automation services.
overview.businessStructure: Posti Group Oyj is a public company owned by the State of Finland.

growthSignals.title: Digital Transformation and AI Experts Recruitment
growthSignals.description: Posti is evolving and its transformation is built by a diverse pool of professionals from postal employees to digital developers and artificial intelligence experts, indicating a strategic focus on digital growth.
growthSignals.sourceExcerpt: Posti is evolving and its transformation is built by a diverse pool of professionals from postal employees to digital developers and artificial intelligence experts.

growthSignals.title: International Career Opportunities and Expansion
growthSignals.description: Posti offers a wide range of positions in Finland and abroad, including in Sweden and the Baltic countries, highlighting its international operations and potential for continued expansion.
growthSignals.sourceExcerpt: We offer a wide range of positions in Finland and abroad: experts from different fields can also find employment in our business operations in Sweden and the Balti developers and artificial intelligence experts. As a large company, we offer an extensive range of opportunities – including internationally.

technologySignals.title: SAP S/4HANA Implementation for Finance
technologySignals.description: Posti has selected Tietoevry as its SAP S/4HANA transformation partner to modernize its current financial technology platform, aiming for increased automation for financial processes.
technologySignals.sourceExcerpt: The Finnish Posti Group is accelerating its digital transformation with Tietoevry by implementing SAP S/4HANA on public cloud... Under the contract, we will provide a new standardized Finance ERP for all Posti Group companies, with increased automation for financial processes.

technologySignals.title: Workday for HR Processes and ESG Data
technologySignals.description: Posti has been using Workday since 2019 for its HR processes and as a major source of its environmental, social and governance (ESG) and GRI data.
technologySignals.sourceExcerpt: Posti had been using Workday since 2019, and has lately used it as a major source of its environmental, social and governance (ESG) and GRI data, as well as its diversity, equity and inclusion.

technologySignals.title: Infor CloudSuite WFM for Workforce Management
technologySignals.description: Posti began migrating to Infor CloudSuite WFM (Workforce Management) in 2020, to simplify shift planning, offer improved user experience including mobile access, and decrease running costs for over 22,000 employees in Finland.
technologySignals.sourceExcerpt: Infor, a global leader in business cloud software specialized by industry, today announced that Finnish postal and logistics leader Posti has begun its migration to Infor CloudSuite WFM (Workforce Management)... The cloud-based application will cover more than 22,000 employees in Finland.

technologySignals.title: Infosys Cobalt for Digitization and Innovation
technologySignals.description: Posti selected Infosys as their digitization and innovation partner, leveraging Infosys Cobalt's transformative services to become a cloud-first organization and creating a mobile app using the Infosys Enterprise Gamification Platform (iEGP) for employee engagement.
technologySignals.sourceExcerpt: While they chose UiPath as their Robotic Process Automation (RPA) partner, Infosys was selected as their digitization and innovation partner. Posti became a cloud-first organization using Infosys Cobalt's numerous transformative services.

technologySignals.title: Key User Role for Warehouse Management Systems
technologySignals.description: A 'Key User' position exists at Posti, responsible for supporting and developing warehouse management systems, maintaining master data, warehouse configurations, and monitoring interfaces and electronic message flows between systems.
technologySignals.sourceExcerpt: As a Key User, you are responsible for supporting and developing our warehouse management systems and related business applications... • System administration - maintaining master data, warehouse configurations, layouts, and supporting warehouse devices, printers, terminals, and related technologies... • Integrations and data flows - monitoring interfaces and electronic message flows between systems and identifying and resolving integration-related issues.

operationalSignals.title: Process Manager, Finance Development Role
operationalSignals.description: A 'Process Manager, Finance Development' role at Posti involves participating in projects as an expert, system responsibility for SAP document circulation systems, and describing and developing processes.
operationalSignals.sourceExcerpt: Process Manager, Finance Development... taloushallinnon tiimissä, osallistuminen projekteihin asiantuntijana, SAP dokumenttien kierrätysjärjestelmän järjestelmävastuu, prosessien kuvaaminen ja kehittäminen, SAP ECC rollout-projektin

operationalSignals.title: Logistics and Operations Management Career Path
operationalSignals.description: Posti Group has a defined career path for Logistics & Operations Management, with roles such as Operations Coordinator, Regional Manager, and Head of Logistics.
operationalSignals.sourceExcerpt: Logistics & Operations Management... Career Progression: Operations Coordinator → Regional Manager → Head of Logistics.

operationalSignals.title: Comprehensive Logistics Services for Businesses
operationalSignals.description: Posti provides a full range of logistics services for businesses, including parcels, letters, transportation, and storage, both in Finland and internationally, aiming to streamline operations.
operationalSignals.sourceExcerpt: At Posti, you’ll find all the sending and receiving services your company needs for efficient logistics, from letters and parcels to storage and transportation.

financials.summary: Posti Group Oyj's net sales in 2025 amounted to EUR 1,447.6 million, with approximately 13,700 employees. The company's net sales in 2024 were EUR 1,521.4 million and adjusted EBITDA was EUR 207.6 million. Posti expects its net sales and adjusted EBITDA in 2025 to be on the previous year's level.

automationOpportunities.title: Enhancing Financial Process Automation with SAP S/4HANA
automationOpportunities.description: Posti is actively undergoing an SAP S/4HANA implementation to modernize its finance platform and increase automation in financial processes. This ongoing transformation presents a clear opportunity for further automation.
automationOpportunities.relevantVelhoService: AI tools, CRM/sales automation and enrichment, ERP integrations, Finance/accounting integrations
automationOpportunities.proposedSolution: Velho can develop custom AI tools and automation workflows tailored to Posti’s new SAP S/4HANA environment. This could include automating invoice processing (OCR, data extraction, matching), expense report processing, general ledger reconciliation, and generating financial reports. Velho could also assist in optimizing data migration and ensuring seamless integration with other financial or operational systems.
automationOpportunities.businessValue: Accelerated financial closing cycles, reduced manual errors in financial data, improved compliance, and cost savings through increased efficiency in financial operations. This would free up finance personnel for more analytical and strategic tasks.
automationOpportunities.scoreExplanation: Very high relevance due to Posti’s explicit ongoing SAP S/4HANA implementation for automation. Strong evidence from press releases and job descriptions. High business impact on core financial processes. Supports growth by enabling more agile financial operations. High automation fit for repetitive and data-intensive financial tasks.
automationOpportunities.hypothesis: Despite the SAP S/4HANA implementation, Posti may still have opportunities for Velho to apply advanced automation and AI within the new ERP system, particularly in areas like intelligent document processing for invoices and enhanced reconciliation processes, to maximize the benefits of their digital transformation.
discoveryQuestions: What are the primary manual tasks remaining in finance after the initial SAP S/4HANA rollout?

automationOpportunities.title: Optimizing Warehouse Management System Support and Development
automationOpportunities.description: Posti has 'Key User' roles dedicated to supporting and developing warehouse management systems (WMS), including master data maintenance, configuration, and monitoring integrations. This indicates ongoing efforts and potential complexities in managing these critical systems.

automationOpportunities.businessValue: Reduced WMS downtime, faster resolution of operational issues, improved data accuracy, and increased efficiency for Key Users, allowing them to focus on strategic development rather than reactive support. This would enhance the overall reliability and performance of Posti's logistics operations.
automationOpportunities.scoreExplanation: High relevance due to direct evidence of dedicated WMS support roles. Strong evidence from job description details. High automation fit for tasks like system monitoring, troubleshooting, and data management.
automationOpportunities.hypothesis: Posti's reliance on Key Users for WMS support and development suggests potential for Velho to introduce AI tools and custom software to automate routine tasks, enhance system stability, and optimize data integrity and integrations within their logistics IT landscape.

automationOpportunities.title: Streamlining Logistics and Operations Administration
automationOpportunities.description: Posti operates extensive logistics services, including parcel, freight, warehousing, and in-house logistics across multiple countries. This scale suggests a significant volume of administrative tasks related to order handling, shipment tracking, customer communication, and supplier coordination.
automationOpportunities.relevantVelhoService: CRM/sales automation and enrichment, Buyer signals, Outreach and follow-ups, Order/shipment and supplier workflows
automationOpportunities.proposedSolution: Develop custom software and AI tools to automate various administrative tasks within logistics. This could include automated order processing from multiple channels, intelligent routing for customer inquiries, automated generation of shipping documents, streamlined supplier communication workflows, and real-time tracking updates integrated with customer-facing platforms. CRM enrichment and sales automation tools could also be implemented.
automationOpportunities.businessValue: Increased operational efficiency, reduced administrative overhead, improved customer satisfaction through faster and more accurate responses, and better coordination with suppliers. This would support Posti's international growth by providing scalable administrative solutions.
automationOpportunities.scoreExplanation: Good relevance due to the extensive nature of Posti's logistics operations. Evidence is indirect, based on the scale of operations rather than explicit manual processes. High potential business impact by optimizing core logistics administration. Supports growth by enabling more efficient handling of increased volumes. Moderate automation fit, as specific manual tasks were not identified but are inferred from scale.
automationOpportunities.hypothesis: Given the scale and international scope of Posti's logistics operations, it's probable that manual or semi-automated administrative tasks exist within order processing, customer communication, and supplier management. Velho can investigate these areas to identify specific opportunities for workflow automation and efficiency gains.
discoveryQuestions: What are the most time-consuming administrative tasks for logistics and operations personnel?

executiveSummary: Posti Group Oyj is a well-established Finnish postal and logistics company with significant operations across the Nordic and Baltic regions. The company is actively investing in digital transformation, including the implementation of SAP S/4HANA for financial processes and leveraging Workday for HR. Posti offers a broad range of logistics services to businesses and consumers and is seeking to enhance its operational efficiency and customer experience. Key automation opportunities for Velho include optimizing warehouse management system support and development, enhancing financial process automation within SAP S/4HANA, and streamlining broader logistics and operations administration. These initiatives align with Posti's strategic focus on digital growth and can yield substantial benefits in efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
limitations: Specific details on the manual nature or inefficiencies of existing operational processes (e.g., explicit spreadsheet use, manual data entry volumes) beyond general descriptions were not found in the public information retrieved. Opportunities are based on logical inference from the company's scale and stated strategic direction.

The precise and most current employee count data showed some discrepancies across different sources; therefore, the provided number is an approximation from the most recent comprehensive annual report.

Information regarding the adoption or specific use of CRM systems (other than general mentions related to customer service and sales) or other specific ERP modules beyond SAP S/4HANA for finance was not explicitly detailed.
The provider did not report complete search/fetch usage. Research coverage is model-reported and could not be independently confirmed.
